_description: L'International des Feux Loto-Quebec (IFLQ) fireworks calendars, La Ronde / Ile Sainte-Helene, Montreal. Single source of truth for firework_anomaly.ipynb and predict_fireworks.py. All shells burst over the St. Lawrence just off the island.

_schema.date: YYYY-MM-DD local date of the show
_schema.time: HH:MM local launch time (24h). The escape-window logic assumes 22:00; verified only for 2025, standard/assumed for other years.
_schema.program: country / theme, or null if not sourced
_schema.pyro_firm: competing pyrotechnics company, or null if not sourced

_notes: Weekday is intentionally NOT stored -- derive it from `date` downstream (pandas dt.day_name()).

The weekday mix varies a lot by year: 2022 ran Wed/Sat, 2023 Thu (+1 Sun), 2024 Thu/Sun/Sat, 2025 Thu/Sun. This cross-year weekday diversity is valuable -- it lets the model prove it reads the demand SHAPE, not just 'is it a Thursday'.
Show COUNT varies: 2022 had 9 shows, 2023/2024/2025 had 8 each.
Launch time is 22:00 for every listed show (festival standard, explicitly confirmed for 2025). If any older show ran at a different time, correct it here -- the escape window depends on it.

2022.source: Official PJCCI (Les Ponts Jacques-Cartier et Champlain) press release, 36th edition. England's Aug 3 slot cross-checks with Wikipedia's 2022 Gold Jupiter winner (Pyrotex Fireworx, England).
2022.note: 9 shows on Wednesdays and Saturdays, post-pandemic full return. Times assumed 22:00 (bridge closed 20:30-23:30 on show nights, consistent).

2023.note: 8 shows, mostly Thursdays with one Sunday (Jul 30). Verify the exact date list against an official/archived press release before treating results as final.

2024.source: propriobateau.ca 2024 edition listing (secondary source). Endpoints (Jun 27 - Aug 1) corroborated by multiple sources; Gold Jupiter 2024: France (Arteventia) per Wikipedia.
2024.note: 8 shows on a mix of Thursdays, Sundays and Saturdays. Verify the mid-season dates against an official press release before treating results as final.

2025.note: 8 shows, all 22:00, six Thursdays + two Sundays.

2026.source: sixflags.com/laronde programmation page (2026 schedule). Dates confirmed; programs/firms not yet sourced.
2026.note: 8 dates, assumed 22:00 launches (verify). Programs unknown pending country reveal.
